definitions.def: to change to suit new conditions or circumstances
a result or effect of an action or condition
to express approval or admiration of someone or something
to keep avoiding or staying away from something
showing signs of future success; likely to turn out well

grammar_choice.en_template: A particularly powerful way in {{1:which/that}} human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by {{2:changing/change}} behaviors in light of the consequences {{3:that/what}} they yield.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 인간이 자신의 환경에 적응하고 맞추어 가는 특히 강력한 한 가지 방법은 그것들이 초래하는 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸는 것을 통해서이다.
explain: 'in 전치사 + 관계대명사' 구조 → in which (the way in which S V).
선행사 consequences를 수식하는 목적격 관계대명사 that (what 불가).

grammar_choice.en_template: For instance, a child {{1:who/which}} gets praised by her teacher for {{2:doing/do}} an exercise correctly is likely to continue {{3:doing/to do}} the exercise in that way.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 예를 들어, 어떤 운동을 올바르게 했다고 선생님에게 칭찬받는 아이는 그 방식으로 그 운동을 계속할 가능성이 높다.

grammar_choice.en_template: A dancer who feels {{1:that/what}} a particular conditioning exercise is not giving any results is likely to give that exercise up in favor of another one {{2:that/what}} seems more {{3:promising/promised}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 어떤 특정한 컨디셔닝 운동이 아무런 결과를 내지 않는다고 느끼는 무용수는 더 유망해 보이는 다른 운동을 위해 그 운동을 포기할 가능성이 높다.
explain: feels의 목적어 명사절을 이끄는 완전한 절 접속사 → that.
선행사 another one을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 → that.

grammar_choice.en_template: In general, we tend to {{1:do/doing}} things that bring us some kind of benefit or {{2:act/acting}} in ways that {{3:help/helps}} us avoid some kind of problem, discomfort, or disadvantage.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 일반적으로, 우리는 우리에게 어떤 이득을 가져다주는 일을 하거나, 어떤 문제·불편·불이익을 피하도록 도와주는 방식으로 행동하는 경향이 있다.
explain: to do와 등위 접속(or) → 동사원형 act.
선행사 ways(복수)를 받는 주격 관계절 동사 → help.

grammar_choice.en_template: We also tend to do {{1:fewer/less}} things (or stop {{2:doing/to do}} things) that lead to problems, discomfort, or disadvantages, and we tend to avoid {{3:acting/to act}} in ways that do not bring any benefit or reward.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 또한 우리는 문제·불편·불이익으로 이어지는 일은 덜 하거나(또는 그만두거나) 하며, 어떤 이득이나 보상도 가져다주지 않는 방식으로 행동하는 것은 피하는 경향이 있다.

jumble.answer: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences that they yield.
For instance, a child who gets praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing the exercise in that way.
A dancer who feels that a particular conditioning exercise is not giving any results is likely to give that exercise up in favor of another one that seems more promising.
In general, we tend to do things that bring us some kind of benefit or act in ways that help us avoid some kind of problem, discomfort, or disadvantage.
We also tend to do fewer things (or stop doing things) that lead to problems, discomfort, or disadvantages, and we tend to avoid acting in ways that do not bring any benefit or reward.
